WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
    AND s.name = '_send_single_request'
    AND s.kind IN ('function','method')
),
reach(symbol_id) AS (
  SELECT e.caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges e
  JOIN target t ON e.callee_symbol_id = t.symbol_id
  WHERE e.calls_directly
    AND e.caller_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
    AND e.callee_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
  UNION
  SELECT e.caller_symbol_id
  FROM code.call_edges e
  JOIN reach r ON e.callee_symbol_id = r.symbol_id
  WHERE e.calls_directly
    AND e.caller_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
    AND e.callee_file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM reach r
JOIN target t ON r.symbol_id <> t.symbol_id
ORDER BY symbol_id
